output.answer: Created solution.py with a merge(a, b) function that uses the two-pointer approach to merge two ascending-sorted lists into a single ascending-sorted list. All 10 tests pass, covering basic merging, empty lists, duplicates, negative numbers, and various edge cases.
output.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+def merge(a, b):
+    """Merge two ascending-sorted lists into a single ascending-sorted list."""
+    result = []
+    i = j = 0
+    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
+        if a[i] <= b[j]:
+            result.append(a[i])
+            i += 1
+        else:
+            result.append(b[j])
+            j += 1
+    result.extend(a[i:])
+    result.extend(b[j:])
+    return result
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@

output.answer: Created solution.py with an LRUCache class using OrderedDict for O(1) get/put operations. The cache evicts the least recently used entry when capacity is exceeded, and both get and put update recency. All 6 tests pass.
output.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+from collections import OrderedDict
+
+
+class LRUCache:
+    def __init__(self, capacity):
+        self.capacity = capacity
+        self.cache = OrderedDict()
+
+    def get(self, key):
+        if key not in self.cache:
+            return -1
+        self.cache.move_to_end(key)
+        return self.cache[key]
+
+    def put(self, key, value):
+        if key in self.cache:
+            self.cache.move_to_end(key)
+        self.cache[key] = value
+        if len(self.cache) > self.capacity:
+            self.cache.popitem(last=False)
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test_solution.py
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+from solution import LRUCache
+
+
+def test_basic_get_put():
+    cache = LRUCache(2)
+    cache.put(1, 1)
+    cache.put(2, 2)
+    assert cache.get(1) == 1
+    assert cache.get(2) == 2
+
+
+def test_eviction():
+    cache = LRUCache(2)
+    cache.put(1, 1)
+    cache.put(2, 2)
+    cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts key 1
+    assert cache.get(1) == -1
+    assert cache.get(2) == 2
+    assert cache.get(3) == 3
+
+
+def test_get_updates_recency():
+    cache = LRUCache(2)
+    cache.put(1, 1)
+    cache.put(2, 2)
+    cache.get(1)  # key 1 becomes most recently used
+    cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts key 2
+    assert cache.get(2) == -1
+    assert cache.get(1) == 1
+    assert cache.get(3) == 3
+
+
+def test_put_updates_existing():
+    cache = LRUCache(2)
+    cache.put(1, 1)
+    cache.put(2, 2)
+    cache.put(1, 10)  # update key 1, no eviction
+    assert cache.get(1) == 10
+    assert cache.get(2) == 2
+
+
+def test_capacity_one():
+    cache = LRUCache(1)
+    cache.put(1, 1)
+    cache.put(2, 2)
+    assert cache.get(1) == -1
+    assert cache.get(2) == 2
+
+
+def test_put_updates_recency():
+    cache = LRUCache(2)
+    cache.put(1, 1)
+    cache.put(2, 2)
+    cache.put(1, 10)  # key 1 becomes most recently used
+    cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts key 2
+    assert cache.get(2) == -1
+    assert cache.get(1) == 10
+    assert cache.get(3) == 3
